title: Abba, son of the executed Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Yevamot 15a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.15a.8-9) tells that Abba married the daughter of his brother Rabban Gamliel and had another wife. Abba died childless. His wife, his brother’s daughter, was an aylonit, so his brother Rabban Gamliel performed levirate marriage with her co-wife.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked Yevamot names Abba as Rabban Gamliel’s brother and describes Gamliel’s levirate marriage with his daughter’s co-wife.
The Gemara discusses whether the daughter was an aylonit and how that status would account for the ruling.

The photographed Hyman notice (vol. I, p. 55) reads Yevamot 15a. The supplied Hebrew transcription gives 46a. Yevamot 15a names Abba as Gamliel’s brother and says that Gamliel himself performed levirate marriage with his daughter’s co-wife. The discussion offers several accounts of why the co-wife was permitted. Hyman’s heading supplies the paternal identification separately.
